text:
Three fallen trees
remained beside the path.
The woodcutter forgot them, and they talk,
pressed close in love, like three blind men.


The setting sun lays
its living blood on the split logs,
and the winds carry away
the fragrance of their open side!


One, twisted, stretches
its immense arm of trembling foliage
toward the other, and its wounds
are like two eyes, full of pleading.


The woodcutter forgot them. Night
will come. I will be with them.


I will receive their gentle
resins in my heart. They will be like fire to me.
And silent, pressed close,
may day find us in a heap of grief!

translation.title: Three Trees
